Kadant’s moat is durable but narrow. Its aftermarket-driven recurring revenue model, technical integration, and digital services create a highly defensible position within targeted niches. However, the company lacks the scale, diversification, and bundled solution capabilities of larger rivals like Valmet and Flowserve, which limits its ability to capture share in broader market downturns or cross-industry expansion. In 2026, Kadant’s competitive resilience will hinge on executing post-acquisition synergies, maintaining aftermarket attachment rates amid cyclical pressure, and justifying its premium valuation through sustained margin expansion rather than top-line growth.
